nodes.label: Sustainability Hero Image
nodes.description: Green leaf with white and green polymer masterbatch pellets suspended in a dynamic water splash. Conveys eco-friendliness, sustainable chemistry, and green manufacturing. Clean white background, high-key studio lighting.
nodes.subject: Sustainability / Eco-friendly masterbatch
nodes.purpose: Hero image for sustainability section or page

nodes.label: Technical Blog Hero Image
nodes.description: A 250ml Erlenmeyer (conical) laboratory flask filled with white and translucent polymer granules/pellets, with pellets scattering outward around it. Represents scientific precision, R&D, and formulation expertise. Monochromatic white/grey palette.
nodes.subject: Laboratory flask with polymer pellets
nodes.purpose: Hero image for technical blog or knowledge base section

nodes.label: Textiles Hero Image
nodes.description: Industrial spool/bobbin of multicoloured synthetic yarn (rainbow spectrum of threads) mounted on a machine spindle. Colourful cylindrical masterbatch pellets scatter in the foreground, visually connecting colourant pellets to the finished coloured fibre product.
nodes.subject: Coloured textile yarn spool with masterbatch pellets
nodes.purpose: Hero image for textiles industry page or product application

nodes.label: White Masterbatch Pellets Hero (Close-up)
nodes.description: Macro close-up of glossy white spherical masterbatch pellets arranged in a loose circular mound on a white background. High-gloss finish suggests TiO2-based white masterbatch. Pure, minimal aesthetic.
nodes.subject: White masterbatch spherical pellets
nodes.purpose: Hero or product image for white masterbatch product page

nodes.label: White Masterbatch Dynamic Hero
nodes.description: White cylindrical masterbatch pellets scattering and dispersing from a smooth white wave or molten plastic curl. Dynamic motion feel with an all-white and off-white palette. Conveys the flow of white masterbatch into the plastic manufacturing process.
nodes.subject: White masterbatch pellets in dynamic dispersion
nodes.purpose: Hero image for white masterbatch product or brand landing section

nodes.label: Wire & Cable Hero Image (Coloured Cables)
nodes.description: ISO 9001-certified MV-Cables rated at 20kV in red, yellow, and black insulation with visible copper conductor cores. Coloured masterbatch pellets (red, yellow, black) explode outward from the cable bundle, visually linking the polymer colourant to the finished cable product.
nodes.subject: Medium-voltage electrical cables with colour masterbatch pellets
nodes.purpose: Hero image for wire & cable industry page or application section

nodes.label: Wire & Cable Hero Image (Heavy-duty Cables)
nodes.description: Heavy-duty black insulated cables (H1Z222-K, 240mm², UV-resistant, EN 50618 standard) by Electra Core, resting on a grey pedestal. Cable ends reveal colour-coded copper cores (red, blue, yellow, bare). Clean industrial studio look with concrete floor backdrop.
nodes.subject: Heavy-duty black electrical cable cross-sections
nodes.purpose: Secondary hero image for wire & cable industry page

nodes.label: Agriculture Industry Image
nodes.description: A large roll of dark green and black agricultural mulch or silage film, with green and black masterbatch pellets dispersing from its surface. Directly connects the coloured polymer pellets to the finished agricultural plastic film product.
nodes.subject: Agricultural film roll with green/black masterbatch pellets
nodes.purpose: Industry card or section image for agriculture vertical

nodes.label: Automotive Industry Image
nodes.description: A dark navy blue automotive interior plastic component (gear shift surround/centre console trim), with dark navy and black masterbatch pellets scattering outward from it. Connects coloured masterbatch to high-precision automotive plastic parts.
nodes.subject: Automotive interior plastic trim with navy masterbatch pellets
nodes.purpose: Industry card or section image for automotive vertical

nodes.label: Construction Industry Image
nodes.description: A tightly rolled black rubber or plastic geomembrane/waterproofing sheet with a textured geometric surface pattern. The roll is compact and heavy-duty, conveying durability and industrial-grade construction material.
